Title: August 27, 2026 City of Boulder City Council Study Session

Topic1.Title: Excel Energy Partnership Update
Topic1.Summary: Excel Energy presented its wildfire mitigation plan, underground feeder projects, the phased transmission rebuild, reliability upgrades adding 120 megawatts, and emissions progress toward 100% emissions-free electricity by 2030. Council asked about rolling outages, restoration times, customer service and billing problems, rate impacts, and support for community resilience tools like micro grids. Council members expressed a need for greater reliability, transparency, and communication, and requested follow-up on several items.

Topic2.Title: Enhancing Boulder's Wildfire Resilience
Topic2.Summary: Staff presented progress on a council priority project to develop a home hardening implementation hub and assess current and planned city wildfire programs. The team outlined a wildfire-initiated community conflagration risk and inventoried roughly 137 projects across 25 programs, with 10 designated tier one priorities. A geographic WOOI risk index grouped western wildland-urban interface areas into risk tiers, and draft measures were introduced for 2030 targets. Council discussed barriers such as contractor access, renter participation, funding options, and whether to pursue mandatory retroactive home hardening, with staff returning in October.
